notes: Reusable JSON for CarbonNxt project-detail pages.
Project types follow the project/methodology areas already included in the CarbonNxt site direction.
All copy is original CarbonNxt-ready wording, not copied from RenewCred.
Do not publish live prices, project counts, registry partnerships, issuance volumes, or certification claims unless confirmed by the client.
Carbon Removal, Emissions Avoidance, and Emissions Reduction are used as classifications, not separate detail pages.

hero.title: Electric Mobility Projects
hero.tagline: Accelerating the shift toward cleaner, lower-emission transport.
hero.description: CarbonNxt supports electric-mobility project developers with project-readiness guidance, monitoring structure, carbon-market positioning and buyer access where applicable eligibility requirements are met.

overview.title: Electric-mobility projects can reduce transport-related greenhouse-gas emissions by replacing higher-emission vehicles or transport systems with electric alternatives.
paragraphs: Electric-mobility projects can reduce transport-related greenhouse-gas emissions by replacing higher-emission vehicles or transport systems with electric alternatives.
Potential activities can include electric fleets, buses, commercial vehicles and organized mobility-transition programs.
CarbonNxt helps developers understand readiness, data needs, monitoring expectations and market pathways.

how_it_works.description: Identify vehicle category, operating model, baseline activity, geography and project boundary.

how_it_works.description: Organize vehicle activity, energy use, distance travelled, fleet records and other relevant data.

certification_readiness.description: Eligibility, baseline selection, additionality, monitoring rules and crediting requirements depend on the methodology and standard selected. CarbonNxt can support developers in organizing project information before formal certification engagement.

developer_relevance.description: CarbonNxt can help EV project owners assess readiness, organize documentation, structure monitoring and prepare for buyer conversations.

faq.question: Can every EV deployment generate carbon credits?
faq.answer: No. Eligibility depends on project structure, methodology, baseline, additionality, monitoring requirements and the selected standard.

faq.answer: Fleet activity, distance travelled, energy use, vehicle details, baseline information and operating records may be relevant.

faq.answer: Yes. The CarbonNxt seller model includes project-readiness and certification guidance before market access.

projects.name: Artisanal Biochar

hero.title: Artisanal Biochar Projects
hero.tagline: Decentralized biochar pathways designed for measurable, long-term carbon storage.
hero.description: CarbonNxt supports small-scale and decentralized biochar models with project-readiness guidance, field-data structure, digital MRV support, certification preparation and buyer access.

overview.title: Artisanal biochar projects can convert suitable biomass residues into stable biochar through controlled production processes.
paragraphs: Artisanal biochar projects can convert suitable biomass residues into stable biochar through controlled production processes.
Because decentralized projects may involve many small production sites, batches, operators and evidence points, strong monitoring and data organization can be especially important.
CarbonNxt can help structure field evidence, production records, MRV workflows, certification readiness and market positioning.

developer_relevance.description: CarbonNxt can help structure the project from field activity to market readiness, including digital evidence, monitoring workflows, certification preparation and buyer matching.

faq.question: How is artisanal biochar different from industrial biochar?
faq.answer: Artisanal biochar generally involves smaller-scale or decentralized production, while industrial biochar typically uses larger centralized systems and more automated process controls.

faq.question: Is field evidence important?
faq.answer: Yes. Decentralized production can require strong batch, feedstock, location, quantity and evidence records depending on the methodology.

faq.question: Can CarbonNxt support digital MRV?
faq.answer: Yes, where appropriate. Digital MRV is one of the CarbonNxt solution areas already included in the website direction.
